subject: vt-u-p
title: (R)VT.U.P.------pol.dy.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-31, the second of three on book p169. (R)VT-U-P — the reality of vibrational universe particulars — is crossed with POL-DY (political dynamics). Besides the main line to POL-DY, three branches leave the subject. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) carries WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) carries AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). LANG-DY (language dynamics) carries INFO-DE-B (information degree basis) → MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance) → PRI-AF-TD (primary affinity tendencies).
